definitions.explanation: First person plural pronoun; refers to the speaker and others in their group.

examples.japanese: {我々|われわれ}は{力|ちから}を{合|あ}わせて{頑張|がんば}らなければならない。
examples.english: We must work together and do our best.

examples.japanese: {我々|われわれ}の{目標|もくひょう}は{明確|めいかく}だ。
{我々|われわれ}{日本人|にほんじん}として{誇|ほこ}りを{持|も}ちたい。
examples.english: As Japanese people, we want to take pride.
examples.notes: 我々 + noun is a common pattern

notes:
USAGE: {我々|われわれ} is a formal/written pronoun meaning "we." It's commonly used in speeches, formal writing, and when emphasizing group identity.

REGISTER: Formal/written. In casual speech, {私|わたし}たち or 僕たち are more common.

CONTRAST:
・{我々|われわれ} - formal "we" (speeches, formal writing)
・{私|わたし}たち - standard polite "we"
・{僕|ぼく}たち - casual "we" (male)
・{俺|おれ}たち - casual "we" (masculine, rough)
・うちら - casual "we" (younger speakers)
